description: Single SoT for companion esbuild --external flags (package.json, package.sh, build-windows-exe.ps1).

notes.sea_rule: Node SEA embedderRequire cannot load filesystem node_modules for bare package ids. Only keep truly native/heavy packages external AND stage them with createRequire(process.execPath) (systray2). Pure-JS deps (MCP SDK, node-notifier, …) MUST be bundled — externalizing them makes launch.bat look like a no-op (hidden VBS crash).
notes.node_notifier: Bundle node-notifier (same SEA failure mode as MCP).
notes.node_pty: #432 @lydell/node-pty is native; SEA must createRequire(process.execPath) + sidecar @lydell tree.
